items.title: Dave Williams Interview, 1974-03-28
items.q: I had Little Willie, Bunnell Sanago, Mitchell Frazier, Simon Frazier, all in the bubble.

ctx.x: Oh, he was a good piano man. Little Willie, sure man. Yeah, I used to admire him, he's playing, you know. Mm-hmm. During that time, uh, a friend of mine was playing, he did, and I called him Bunnell Sanago. Mm-hmm. And I'm catching to meet during that time and see who could outplay one another, you know. Mm-hmm. I had Little Willie, Bunnell Sanago, Mitchell Frazier, Simon Frazier, all in the bubble. I was under those parts, and they was playing too much for me. And they'll meet, man, and on Mondays, and tell me…

items.title: Dave Williams Interview, 1961-07-02
items.q: And he got another boy, he's still living, Simon Frazier.

ctx.x: How was he related to Sae for instance? Oh, they were related for his cousin.
First cousin. Yeah, him, Sae and my mother, their first cousin. And he got another boy, he's still living, Simon Frazier.

Yeah, Simon, I've heard him play a couple of times. He used to be over playing with Punch a few nights, about four years ago. I haven't seen him since. Oh, another good pianist I missed hearing is, I can't think of it, Lewis, you know, with P-Roll. What's his name?
